subject: Pilot trial extension request — integration delays at Olive Systems
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@olivesys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>; Dylan Turner <dylan.turner@olivesys.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot trial extension request — integration delays at Olive Systems

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — we appreciate how quickly your team turned around the demo. I wanted to surface an issue that came up this morning during our integration sprint that affects our ability to complete the pilot on the current timetable.

Summary: our engineering team hit a compatibility problem between our Kafka connector and the Redwood SDK that causes repeated socket timeouts when we push >10k events/min. We’ve attached a short integration_log.txt and one screenshot of the most frequent error (sample_error.png). Our infra lead (cc’d: Dylan) is triaging and expects a targeted fix but it will take time to validate across our staging topologies.

Ask: given the blocker, can Redwood approve a 30-day trial extension and a temporary top-up of inference credits so we don’t hit quota before the connector is stabilized? A 30-day buffer would let our SREs finish the upgrade, run performance tests, and give your team time to validate the kernel path we need for our workload.

Proposed timeline:
- Jun 12–16: remediation and internal QA
- Jun 17–22: joint validation with Redwood engineering
- Jun 23–30: ramp to pilot throughput

If helpful, I can share a short runbook and a list of blocked endpoints tomorrow. We’re committed to the pilot and would prefer to keep momentum rather than restart later. Please let us know what additional info you need to approve the extension.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Platform
Olive Systems
Attachments: integration_log.txt (log snippet), sample_error.png (screenshot)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@olivesys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot trial extension request — integration delays at Olive Systems

Emma —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear you hit that window; we’ve seen similar connector edge-cases before and I want to get engineering eyes on it quickly. Looping in Marissa (CS) to coordinate the commercial side and Karthik (eng/sales) for a technical triage.

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm what we can approve immediately (extension length, one-off credits) vs what needs manager sign-off? Emma — could you send the runbook and a quick list of the endpoints that fail under load? That will help Karthik reproduce locally.

I’ll prepare an internal note and a draft MAP (mutual action plan) we can sign off on once we agree on dates. Attaching a short MAP stub to this thread for tracking.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_olive_2027-06-12.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@olivesys.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot trial extension request — integration delays at Olive Systems

Hi Emma,

Appreciate the quick note and the artifacts — that helps. On Jun 12, 2027, at 09:15 AM, Emma Li <emma.li@olivesys.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — we appreciate how quickly your team turned around the demo. I wanted to surface an issue that came up this morning during our integration sprint that affects our ability to complete the pilot on the current timetable.

We can offer a provisional 30-day extension to the pilot and a 2,000 inference-credit top-up while your team remediates, pending a short technical validation by Karthik’s team. This is an interim measure — final approval for any additional top-up will require sign-off from our sales manager, but the extension itself we can apply today from our side to avoid disruption.

Next steps I suggest:
- Emma: share the runbook and a prioritized list of failing endpoints (by EOD Jun 13).
- Karthik: run the reproducer and confirm whether the socket timeouts map to a kernel selection/serialization mismatch. If it’s straightforward we can push a runtime tweak to avoid throttling during the pilot.
- Ben: once we have Karthik’s notes, Marissa will convert this into a signed MAP and confirm the credit top-up.

Emma — I’ll put the provisional extension and credit top-up in the system; please confirm the public cloud region you’re testing in (us-west-2 or us-east-1).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma.li@olivesys.com>

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks, this is great news and exactly what we needed. On Jun 13, 2027, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> We can offer a provisional 30-day extension to the pilot and a 2,000 inference-credit top-up while your team remediates, pending a short technical validation by Karthik’s team.

We’ve completed the initial runbook and attached it to this reply (runbook excerpt pasted below). We’re testing in us-west-2. Expected remediation: Jun 18 (hotfix deployed) and full verification by Jun 22. If all goes well we’ll be back to the agreed pilot throughput the week of Jun 23.

Runbook excerpt:
- Step 1: reproduce timeout with connector_v1.4 on staging
- Step 2: apply socket backlog patch (patch details omitted)
- Step 3: run 2x load test (10k/min sustained, 95th p99 latency target)

Please consider this confirmation of the dates above; if you can add the provisional extension and credits to our HubSpot deal and send the signed MAP link (DocuSign or URL), we’ll authorize the extra runway on our side. Much appreciated.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Platform, Olive Systems
Attachments: runbook_excerpt.txt
